preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and edges m satisfy the given constraints.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges are within the valid range of vertices.
The number of edges matches the given count.

postconditions.expression: any(a == nasya_position or b == nasya_position or c == nasya_position for a, b, c in bee_positions)
postconditions.description: At least one bee is at the same vertex as Nastya at any point.
The number of moves does not exceed the number of vertices.
